event.title: RAG DAY 2026
event.subtitle: The biggest celebration of the year of CSE at University of Asia Pacific
event.venue: UAP Campus, 74/B Green Road, Dhanmondi, Dhaka-1205
event.about: RAG Day is the biggest celebration of the year at University of Asia Pacific — a day when classes pause, the campus turns into a festival ground, and students from every department come together for music, games, food and unforgettable memories.

schedule.title: Opening Ceremony
schedule.desc: National anthem, flag hoisting and welcome speech by the Vice Chancellor.

schedule.title: Campus Rally & Banner Parade
schedule.desc: Students march across the campus with departmental banners and colorful face paint.

schedule.title: Cultural Show & Music
schedule.desc: Band performances, dance, drama and singing competitions on the main stage.

schedule.title: Food Festival
schedule.desc: Departmental food stalls — biryani, fuchka, chotpoti, jhalmuri and much more.

schedule.title: Games & Sports
schedule.desc: Tug of war, cricket, sack race, 3-legged race and inter-department battles.

schedule.title: Grand Concert & DJ Floor
schedule.desc: Guest band performance, then the DJ floor opens for everyone.

schedule.title: Prize Giving & Closing
schedule.desc: Winners announced, department group photos, and the official end of RAG Day.

programs.title: Inter-Department Battle of the Bands
programs.desc: Top campus bands compete for the RAG trophy on the main stage.

programs.title: Face Painting & T-Shirt Stalls
programs.desc: Get your department logo painted and grab the official RAG Day tee.

programs.title: Photo Booth & Memory Wall
programs.desc: Themed photo corners and a giant wall to leave messages for friends.

programs.title: Gaming & E-Sports Zone
programs.desc: FIFA, PUBG and chess tournaments with instant prizes.

programs.title: Cultural Dance & Drama
programs.desc: Traditional and modern performances by UAP cultural clubs.

programs.title: DJ Night Warm-up
programs.desc: The campus lights go down and the DJ takes over till closing.

rules: Wear your UAP student ID card at all times inside the campus.
Respect every participant — no harassment of any kind will be tolerated.
Keep the campus clean; use the provided dustbins.
Outside guests are allowed only with a valid guest pass.
Follow the instructions of volunteers and security teams.
No political banners or slogans are allowed on RAG Day.
